label: React + Vite + Tailwind + TypeScript (SPA)
use_when: The product is a client-side application behind a login, where indexability does not matter
There is no server-rendering requirement and no server-side data loading
A lighter build and a plain static host are preferable to a framework runtime

smoke.note: `--host 127.0.0.1` is load-bearing. vite preview otherwise binds to `localhost`, which resolves to IPv6 ::1 on many machines -- localhost answers 200 while 127.0.0.1 refuses the connection, so the probe times out against a server that is running fine. This validates the scaffold serves, nothing about the product.

architecture.note: Same mental model as the Next profile, with an explicit router and providers entry point instead of file-system routing. Create a directory when something needs it -- do not precreate the tree.

checks.axe: pass (0 violations on the baseline route)

validated.note: Exact resolved versions live in the template's package.json and package-lock.json, which are the authority. This block records what was actually run, not what is expected to work.

notes: This profile lints with oxlint, not ESLint, and pins TypeScript 6 -- both are what the current Vite scaffold ships. The Next profile is on ESLint and TypeScript 5. That divergence is intentional and is why the profiles are separate: neither one is a house style imposed on the other.

vite preview binds to `localhost`, which resolves to IPv6 ::1 on many machines. The server then answers on localhost but refuses 127.0.0.1, and a test runner waiting on the IPv4 address times out reporting that the server never started. playwright.config.ts pins `--host 127.0.0.1` for exactly this reason -- do not remove it.

@axe-core/playwright is CommonJS with an ESM wrapper. Under `module: nodenext` a default import resolves to the module namespace and is not constructable. Use the named `AxeBuilder` export; it works under both resolutions and needs no compiler-option workaround.

tsconfig is a project-reference build (`tsc -b`) with three configs: app (src, DOM), node (vite.config.ts) and e2e (specs and playwright.config.ts, DOM plus node types). Files outside src are not typechecked unless a config includes them -- adding a directory at the root means adding it to one of these.
Tailwind 4 is wired through the @tailwindcss/vite plugin, not a PostCSS config. There is no tailwind.config.js: theme tokens live in src/index.css inside @theme.
